def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The grid is split by the gray lines into equal tiles. Repeat the
    # non-background marks from the populated lower-right tile.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg, line = 5, 3
    row_line = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == line for v in row))
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == line for r in range(h))]
    rh, cw = row_line, col_lines[0]
    template = grid[row_line+1:row_line+1+rh]
    template = [row[col_lines[-1]+1:col_lines[-1]+1+cw] for row in template]
    row_starts = [0, row_line+1]
    col_starts = [0] + [c+1 for c in col_lines]
    for rs in row_starts:
        for cs in col_starts:
            for i in range(rh):
                for j in range(cw):
                    value = template[i][j]
                    if value != bg:
                        out[rs+i][cs+j] = value
    return out

code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if sep_cols:
        boundaries = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
        segments = [(boundaries[i]+1, boundaries[i+1]) for i in range(len(boundaries)-1)]
        src0, src1 = segments[0]
        for a,b in segments[1:]:
            for r in range(h):
                for j in range(min(src1-src0,b-a)):
                    v=grid[r][src0+j]
                    if v != bg: out[r][a+j]=v
    elif sep_rows:
        boundaries = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
        segments = [(boundaries[i]+1,boundaries[i+1]) for i in range(len(boundaries)-1)]
        a,b=segments[0]
        for x,y in segments[1:]:
            for i in range(min(b-a,y-x)):
                for c,v in enumerate(grid[a+i]):
                    if v != bg: out[x+i][c]=v
    return out
'''
